title: The Body Has Many Uses (3)
subtitle: Body idioms for big talk, angry answers, high prices, and jokes.

idioms.mean: talk loudly and carelessly, often boasting
idioms.ex: He's always **shooting off his mouth** about how rich his family is.
I only asked a question! You don't have to **jump down my throat**.

idioms.mean: pay far too much for something
idioms.ex: We **paid through the nose** for drinks at the airport.

idioms.mean: said as a joke, not seriously
idioms.ex: His review calling the movie a masterpiece was **tongue-in-cheek**. He actually hated it.

tip: **Tongue-in-cheek** adalah adjective/adverb: *a tongue-in-cheek comment*, *he said it tongue-in-cheek*. **Pay through the nose** sering dipakai dengan *for*: *pay through the nose for tickets*.

dialogue.q: A: This small coffee cost 80,000 rupiah! B: Wow, you really ___.
dialogue.why: Terlalu mahal → paid through the nose.

dialogue.q: A: Is the homework due today? B: Of course! Don't you ever listen?! A: Hey, no need to ___!
dialogue.why: Dijawab dengan marah → jump down my throat.

dialogue.q: A: Did Dimas really say he can beat a pro gamer? B: Yes, but he's always ___.
dialogue.why: Omong besar → shooting off his mouth.

dialogue.q: A: She said our team is 'the best in the universe'. B: Relax, it was ___. We lost every match!

correct.q: "We got the tickets for free. We really paid through the nose!"
correct.why: Salah: gratis berarti tidak bayar mahal.

correct.q: "Sorry I jumped down your throat. I was tired and stressed."
"She shot off her mouth because she was too shy to speak."
correct.why: Salah: shoot off one's mouth = banyak omong, bukan pemalu.

speak.q: Have you ever paid through the nose for something? Was it worth it?
speak.model: Yes, I <mark>paid through the nose</mark> for concert tickets last year. They were really expensive, but the show was amazing, so I think it was worth it.
speak.label: pay through the nose

speak.q: What do you do when someone jumps down your throat?
speak.model: When someone <mark>jumps down my throat</mark>, I try to stay calm. Usually they are just stressed, so I wait a little and then talk to them again.
speak.label: jump down someone's throat

speak.q: Do you know someone who often shoots off their mouth?
speak.model: Yes, one of my classmates often <mark>shoots off his mouth</mark>. He says he can win every game, but most of the time he loses, so we just laugh.
speak.label: shoot off one's mouth

roleplay.situation: Kamu dan temanmu baru pulang dari liburan singkat dan menceritakannya ke teman lain.
steps: **Student A:** ceritakan harga hotel / makanan yang sangat mahal (*we paid through the nose*).
**Student B:** bercanda bahwa liburannya 'paling murah sedunia' lalu jelaskan itu bercanda (*tongue-in-cheek*).
**Student A:** ceritakan teman seperjalanan yang suka omong besar (*shooting off his/her mouth*).
**Student B:** ceritakan saat teman itu tiba-tiba membentak (*jumped down my throat*) dan bagaimana kalian berbaikan.
roleplay.target: Target: percakapan 1–2 menit, semua 4 idiom terpakai. Bonus: pakai 2 idiom dari Sesi 1–2.
